# mutation-lite

Lightweight, deterministic AST-based mutation testing library for Python. No runtime dependencies. Python >= 3.10.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Quick start, API overview, and design philosophy.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): AST-based mutation logic and runner protocol.
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): Coverage policies and test execution.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat model and sandbox recommendations.
- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): Technology decisions.
